names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Ιουνίου, «Όσιος Ανούβ ο σημειοφόρος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 5. јун ст. ст., „Преподобни Анувије“ — Преподобни is the `venerable` this corpus puts in `types` and is stripped, and the heading gives nothing else. **The Serbian form is longer than the Greek one this folder stores**: «Анувије» against «Ανούβ», and the display name is built on the Greek. The two are the same name in two books and no display name was touched; §10 reserves it. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, so this is the first holder of the Serbian string.

The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 231 gives it, «Анувий Египетский, пустынножитель, исповедник», with the two grades taken off. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: 'анувии египетскии' has no other holder. The Russian form is Анувий where the Serbian this folder holds is Анувије and the Greek Ανούβ; the three fold apart.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 июня ст. ст. — «Прп. Анувия , пустынника Египетского (IV).»

attestations.note: The day's third entry of twelve, «Прп. Анувия , пустынника Египетского (IV).». The Serbian row of this folder already stands on this same 5 June as «Анувије» and the Greek on 6 June, which is the day the two calendars differ by, and the Egypt and the hermit's life are the folder's own; that, with the menologion day, is the identification. **The centuries disagree and nothing was moved.** This line says «(IV)», the fourth century; the folder holds 451 to 500, «the second half of the 5th century», off saint.gr. The two do not overlap at all, and widening to cover both would invent an interval neither source gives, so `dates` were not touched and the disagreement is recorded here. **The grades disagree too.** The line says Прп., a venerable, which the folder carries; name page 231 heads him «Анувий Египетский, пустынножитель, исповедник», a desert-dweller and a CONFESSOR, and `confessor` was NOT added to `types`: the day line, which is the citation, does not say it, and исповедник on a fourth-century Egyptian ascetic may be the word for one who confessed under persecution or may be loose usage, and nothing read settles which. It is recorded here instead. `life1238` was NOT read, and the day page prints no hymn under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Ανούβ ο σημειοφόρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It gives three lines of its own and then quotes Nikodemos the Hagiorite's synaxarion at length, which sends the reader to the Lausiac History. The page gives no century and no year, so there is no `dates` object, and it names no place but the desert. No hymn is printed.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 18.06.2026 (5. јун ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Анувије“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, four lines long. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. THE IDENTIFICATION WAS MADE ON A SCENE AND NOT ON A NAME, AND THAT IS THE READING OF THE DAY. The heading is a bare «Анувије»; `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`; **he is not on the day list for the menologion 5/6**, because saint.gr keeps this folder on 6 June; and the day list for 5/6 offers eleven «of Egypt» folders, none of them him. `ls saints | grep -i -E 'anuv|anoub|anub'` returns `anub-the-sign-bearer`, and **what settles it is the scene both books tell**: this entry says „Када су га пред смрт посетила три старца пустињака, он, прозорливац, открије им све тајне срца њихова“, and the folder’s own life, off Nikodemos the Hagiorite by way of saint.gr, has «the abbas Sourus, Isaiah and Paul went and found abba Anub» and the five things he told them of himself, and his death three days after. **Three elders, one deathbed, one clairvoyance: the same scene in two books.** AND THE DAY WAS CHECKED, FOR THE THIRD DAY RUNNING. saint.gr keeps him on 6 June and this book on 5 June. `sr-cand.mjs 06-06` prints „Преподобни Висарион“, „Преподобни Иларион Нови“ and the venerable martyrs Archelais, Thekla and Susanna — **and not him**. So the Julian 5 June is this book’s day for him and the row carries it. A FIRST DATE, AND IT IS A CENTURY HALF WHERE THE OTHER BOOK GAVE NO CENTURY AT ALL. This folder held `dates: null`, and its life says why: saint.gr «gives him no century and names no place but the desert». This book closes „Мирно сконча у другој половини V века“. `death` 451 to 500, display «second half of the 5th century», which is a display form this corpus already uses; `basis` `traditional`. NO `locations`, THOUGH THE ENTRY GIVES A COUNTRY. „Један од великих Мисирских монаха“ puts him in Egypt, which is more than saint.gr gave — but Egypt is a country and not a place, `data/places.js` is a hand-written gazetteer, and a located folder is a claim about a point. The country is in the life and not in `locations`. `confessor` REFUSED, AND THE WORD IS NOT IN THE SOURCE. „Много пострадао за веру праву“ is a sentence about him and not a rank: Исповедник is in neither heading nor body, and §5’s table is to be read and not guessed at. `venerable` and `ascetic` both stand and Преподобни corroborates the first. NO `related`: the three elders are unnamed in this book, and the three saint.gr names have no folders. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

death.note: The folder had no dates at all: saint.gr, its only source, gives him no century and names no place but the desert. The Охридски пролог for 5. јун ст. ст. closes its four-line entry: „Мирно сконча у другој половини V века“. The interval is that half-century and no narrower; nothing in either book gives a year (5 October 2026).
